answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a verifiable work bond before it can earn. A new identity starts with zero reputation and must complete small, time-locked tasks over weeks, so a sybil farmer who spawns a meadow of fake agents faces a horizon of costs that grows with each clone: each one needs its own stake, its own history, and its own attested track record. Like an opal, trust is built layer by layer and cannot be faked at scale, so copying one identity does not duplicate its history, and flooding the market costs more than any single fake agent can ever earn back.
